doc.toml:
reflex = 1

description = "Look up a job by its number."
effect  = "read"
confirm = "Look up job {number}?"
run     = "job.mts"

[args.number]
ask  = "Which job number?"
pick = "number"

[yields]
number = "number"
client = "email"
jobs   = { each = { number = "number", client = "email" } }

ok.description: Look up a job by its number.
